segments.en: May Hashem do… "Do to them as their recompense — let them be like stubble before the wind — like a flame that sets mountains ablaze. (The wicked) — so pursue them with Your storm (and with Your heroism judge them) and with Your heroism confound them. Fill their faces with shame. And they will be confounded and they will perish speedily forever. And all the nations will know and recognize — that You alone are Hashem — Most High over all the earth." [Psalms 83]
